args.query: Three.js WebGPU renderer with a TSL compute shader for particles

results.title: Vue 3 SSR with renderToString
results.summary: Server-render a Vue 3 app built with defineComponent and h(), covering props, computed, list rendering and provide/inject, then assert the HTML output offline.

results.title: structlog JSONRenderer routed through stdlib logging, captured in pytest
results.summary: Configure structlog to render one JSON line per event via stdlib logging and ProcessorFormatter, then cover the pytest side offline: caplog holds the event dict (not the JSON), format_exc_info keeps tracebacks JSON-safe, passing default= to JSONRenderer disables the __structlog__ hook, and reconfiguring never stacks handlers.

results.title: Yup schemas for signup forms with conditional rules
results.summary: Build a Yup v1 signup schema with refs for password confirmation, when() conditional fields, transforms and InferType, collecting every error per field.

results.title: inflect plurals, ordinals, a/an articles and number-to-words for UI strings
results.summary: Build count-aware English labels with inflect: singular for one, irregular plurals, 11/12/13-safe ordinals, sound-based articles and spelled-out numbers.

results.title: Natural sorting with natsort for filenames, versions and paths
results.summary: Sort filenames and version strings the way humans expect with natsort, using IGNORECASE and PATH flags, parallel-list ordering and the FLOAT algorithm for decimals.

results.title: Hypothesis property tests for Pydantic v2 models
results.summary: Property-based tests with Hypothesis on Pydantic v2 models: JSON round trips, validator invariants, and a stateful RuleBasedStateMachine for a small inventory class.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK streaming chat completions, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream chat completion deltas with the OpenAI SDK (for await over chunks), accumulate text and usage, and handle aborts, tested offline with a fake fetch that returns an SSE body.

results.title: pino logging with redaction, request context and a custom transport
results.summary: A pino 10 logger with path and wildcard redaction, error serialisers, string levels and an AsyncLocalStorage mixin for request ids, plus a pino-abstract-transport alert sink combined via multistream, tested offline against in-memory streams.

results.title: ws WebSocket server with a Zod-validated message protocol
results.summary: A room chat server on the ws library with token auth on the upgrade URL, a Zod 4 discriminated union for every inbound frame and typed error replies, tested offline with real ws clients on an ephemeral localhost port.

results.title: APScheduler job triggers tested deterministically with time-machine
results.summary: Compute CronTrigger and IntervalTrigger fire times without a running scheduler, and test them offline by freezing the clock with time-machine.
